preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 5.
The number of points N must be between 1 and 500,000.
The integer c must be greater than 0 and less than or equal to 1 billion.
Each point (x_i, y_i) must have coordinates within the range of -1 billion to 1 billion.

postconditions.description: The output must contain two integers representing the minimum number of checkpoints and the minimum number of moves.

raw_response: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"1 <= T <= 5","description":"The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 5."},{"id":"P2","expression":"1 <= N <= 500000","description":"The number of points N must be between 1 and 500,000."},{"id":"P3","expression":"0 < c <= 1000000000","description":"The integer c must be greater than 0 and less than or equal to 1 billion."},{"id":"P4","expression":"all(-1000000000 <= x_i <= 1000000000 and -1000000000 <= y_i <= 1000000000 for x_i, y_i in points)","description":"Each point (x_i, y_i) must have coordinates within the range of -1 billion to 1 billion."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"stdout == f'{min_checkpoints} {min_moves}'","description":"The output must contain two integers representing the minimum number of checkpoints and the minimum number of moves."}],"invariants":[]}
